description: A combo box that displays a multi-column grid in its dropdown for rich item selection.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether to show a clear button. Default is true.

parameters.name: Filterable
parameters.description: Placeholder shown when no value is selected.

parameters.name: FilterPlaceholder
parameters.description: Whether the user can filter the dropdown list. Default is true.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Expression that returns the display text for the trigger when an item is selected.

parameters.name: TextField
parameters.description: Expression that returns the value for a given item. Required for selection matching.

parameters.name: ValueField
parameters.description: Data source for the dropdown grid.
